assembledPrompt:
You have been provided with the plan-implementation SKILL.md as your system prompt.

Execute the SKILL.md's complete workflow.

Slug: {slug}

Inputs (read from disk):
  - .dlc/{slug}/designs/tech-design.md (Work Item Registry is the primary task source)
  - .dlc/{slug}/plans/_iteration-state.md (if exists - skip already-delivered Epics)

The workflow should:
  1. Parse the tech design's Work Item Registry (WI-x table).
  2. Group work items into Epics (5-15 tasks per Epic, S-L combined effort).
  3. Select the next Epic from the backlog.
  4. Decompose into atomic, agent-executable tasks (T-NNN per Epic) with
     exact file paths, acceptance criteria, and test commands.
  5. Verify dependencies form a DAG.

Required artifacts:
  - .dlc/{slug}/plans/epic-NNN.plan.md (the new Epic plan)
  - .dlc/{slug}/plans/_iteration-state.md (updated with new Epic + backlog)

When done, print exactly: PLAN_IMPLEMENTATION_DONE
Then list: Epic number, task count, total effort, dependencies on prior Epics.
